description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: lib/zaq/agent/executor.ex, narrowly necessary api.ex/Factory context propagation and tests; preserve existing lib/zaq/engine/messages/outgoing.ex builder, extending only if a proven missing field boundary is found. Pass the logical-server alias scope into StreamEvents, carry its successful final attachments list through Executor's result map and Outgoing.from_pipeline_result, and preserve it in Agent.Api's role result. Keep actor-bound configured-agent execution and trusted event identity; never port reference flat person_id/team_ids context fields.
Success emits exactly the final verified Records; text-only/no-tool/clear emits []. Failed, cancelled, timeout, pre-stream error, refusal, handoff and partial/suppressed terminal paths carry no selected files. Incoming.attachments are prompt input only, never implicitly echoed. Do not change existing buffered text delivery, accepted-answer correlation, tool evidence, measurements or routing/connector/thread identity. Do not add delivery/error wrappers, plans, prepared content or selection-failure transport metadata. RunAgent/NotifyPerson/Notifications are intentionally untouched.
Tests to add before implementation: configured Executor.run -> real Factory/native Action -> StreamEvents -> canonical Outgoing; verify add A/add B/remove A yields B in original selected routing; empty/no-tool and incoming-only remain text. Exercise all terminal/error/refusal/handoff branches and reused-server next request, checking attachments cleared and prior text/tool evidence invariants preserved. Add Agent.Api trusted actor/event round-trip and JSON Record validation tests without materializing files. Assert no signed capabilities/content in public tool/status metadata and no automatic delivery claim from tool success.
Branches/paths validated: success, runtime reused/cold start, alias scope forwarded, pending streamed answer, prior placeholder identity, handled errors with partial result, denied/missing actor, selected-connection/routing unchanged.
Mocking plan: ToolCallingLLMStub at LLM HTTP boundary, actual Registry/Jido/Record/builder/role contracts. Existing injectable status/router edges may capture events without replacing business logic; real role integration belongs to the next task. Unique configured runtime/Person fixtures, monitored cleanup, no global mutations.
Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: Executor/StreamEvents output docs and docs/services/agent.md ordinary Agent propagation; docs/services/channels.md only if the existing builder contract needs clarification.
Action reuse assessment: extend Executor -> Factory.ask_with_config configured path and reuse Outgoing.from_pipeline_result. No new ask/session/send helper. Input successful stream result + trusted Incoming -> existing Outgoing with attachments; preserve all other outputs/errors and security defaults. PR7 consumers remain deferred. Immediate tests demonstrate a single validated Action and canonical builder rather than a parallel response map.

Implementation handoff: Scope and sequence approved by the user on 2026-11-28. This turn records the plan only; application implementation, commits, pushes, rebases and dependency publication are not performed or authorized by this planning update. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before execution. Read applicable service guides and module responsibilities; Agent work requires the harness-critical checks; BO work requires DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md. Recheck live source and dependency contracts. Preserve existing test behavior unless specifically approved. Write immediate unit/integration/property tests before corresponding code; new browser journeys wait for the human UX gate. Keep real internal boundaries, mock only external edges, and inject runtime dependencies through existing opts/context and Zaq.Config. Follow the owning validation lifecycle. PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.

comments.text: Configured propagation implemented with exactly two Executor additions: forward logical-server opaque_alias_scope to existing StreamEvents.consume and pass successful final attachments to existing Outgoing.from_pipeline_result. Factory, Agent.Api, Outgoing, Channels delivery, Engine, PR7 consumers and dependency pins are unchanged. New real LLM-boundary/native/Registry/ACL/NodeRouter/disk integration proves add A, failed forged selection, corrected add B, remove A -> only B; next request with incoming files emits no attachments. Real source grant revocation rejects stale signed metadata. Real provider failure after selection emits none. Agent.Api trusted-actor legacy configured response retains the verified Record list. Model HTTP history and outgoing diagnostics contain no source bytes/full capabilities. The final B also traverses actual PR5 preparation/materialization/dispatch/Engine confirmation with only the external chat adapter controlled; exact uploaded bytes/name and confirmed-only saved history asserted, once, after deleting A. Final mix q and 502 focused checks passed. Full real-provider/browser acceptance is pending external/package/UX gates; no delivery readiness claim for unsupported pins.
